note: First concrete instance of the K'UHUL GPU Resource Contract (KGRC): the model becomes persistent GPU state whose residence/affinity/budget are explicit. KGRC itself is not built yet (Stage D) — this contract documents the resource semantics this proof already satisfies, borrowing GPUSync (Elliott & Anderson, RTSS 2013) engine/affinity/budget/critical-section concepts.

gpu.class: integrated (system-memory; discrete-GPU migration model does NOT map 1:1)

affinity.definition: Affinity(M,G) = residence(weights) + residence(exec-graph) + residence(activations) on G

residency.weights: required (uploaded once, keyed by pointer; all 12 layers + ln_f + lm_head resident)
residency.compiled_operators: required (distinct op types compiled once, reused across layers)
residency.binding_tables: required (per-layer, pointing at that layer's resident weights)
residency.activations: resident on-device across the whole forward (hidden states + Q/K/V + scratch)

budget.syncs_per_forward: ~1 per layer + lm_head (record-all + single flush in this build)
budget.note: budgets are descriptive measurements here, not yet enforced laws (that is KGRC/XCFE, Stage D-E)

critical_section.acquire: D3D12 device + DML device + resident upload (Pop/Wo)
critical_section.execute: 12 fused layers + ln_f + lm_head recorded to one command list (Yax/Sek)

honest_scope: Single forward at seq_len=8; no KV-cache / generation loop (Proof #002/#003).
DirectML GELU is erf; the driver default is tanh — same predicted token, 2.51e-04 logit gap over 12 layers.
Standalone proof; not wired behind the driver or ggml-xcfe.
KGRC/XCFE resource arbitration (affinity/lease/budget enforcement) is Stage D-E, not built.
